title: Springtime Blooms
intro: [excited] Welcome to the springtime episode of Disney Jeopardy! The flowers are blooming, the birds are singing, and [laughs] everybody is a little bit twitterpated.

art.prompt: A sunny spring garden at a theme park: blooming tulip beds, a shrub sculpted into a giant butterfly, cherry blossom trees by a lagoon, a geodesic sphere glowing in the distance, butterflies in the air, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Twitterpated
categories.intro: First, spring in the forest with Bambi. [chuckles] Watch out for twitterpation.

art.prompt: A spring forest glade with morning sun beams, fresh green leaves, wildflowers, a babbling brook, a hollow tree and a gentle April rain shower sparkling in the light, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Bambi, this shy skunk happily accepts the name Flower.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flower! [laughs] Bambi called him Flower and he just went with it.

clues.clue: According to Friend Owl, in springtime everyone gets this goofy word for being lovestruck.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is twitterpated! [chuckles] You're walking along, minding your own business...

clues.clue: This doe is Bambi's childhood friend, and later, his mate.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Faline! [excited] She caught his eye in the meadow.

clues.clue: In Bambi, a sudden spring rainstorm in the forest is set to this song.
choices: Let's Sing a Gay Little Spring Song
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Little April Shower! Drip, drip, drop. [laughs] Even the rain is musical in this movie.

clues.clue: Bambi was based on a 1923 novel by this Austrian author.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Felix Salten! [whispers] Bambi, a Life in the Woods.

categories.title: Petals at EPCOT
categories.intro: Next, the EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival. [excited] Bring your allergy pills!

art.prompt: A world-class garden festival around a lagoon: tulip beds in rainbow stripes, a huge butterfly made from living flowers, hanging baskets, a garden train winding through miniature villages, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Flower & Garden Festival is famous for these shrubs sculpted into the shapes of Disney characters.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is topiaries! [laughs] Their haircuts take longer than mine.

clues.clue: A model railway winds through a tiny village in this World Showcase pavilion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Germany! [chuckles] Gardening on a very, very small scale.

clues.clue: The festival's concert series has the gardening-pun name Garden this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Garden Rocks! [excited] Bands on stage, flowers all around.

clues.clue: The EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival first bloomed in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1994! [gasps] Decades of blooming since.

clues.clue: A single tomato tree grown at EPCOT's Land pavilion set a Guinness record by producing more than 32,000 of these in one year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tomatoes! 32,194 of them. [laughs] That's a lot of salsa.

categories.title: Secret Gardens
categories.intro: Now, gardens and green thumbs from all over the Disney world. [chuckles]

art.prompt: A hidden walled garden behind an ivy-covered gate, a rose maze, a willow tree by a pond, a glass greenhouse glowing in sunlight, garden tools leaning against a stone wall, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Alice in Wonderland, the Queen of Hearts' card soldiers are painting these red.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the roses! They planted white ones by mistake. [gasps] Off with their heads!

clues.clue: In Encanto, this Madrigal sister can make flowers bloom anywhere.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Isabela! [excited] And when she lets loose, cactuses bloom too.

clues.clue: In Pocahontas, this wise old talking tree gives Pocahontas advice.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Grandmother Willow! [chuckles] Listen with your heart.

clues.clue: Disney's 1932 short Flowers and Trees was the first commercially released film in full three-strip this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Technicolor! It also won the very first Oscar for animated short. [excited] A beautiful bloom.

clues.clue: EPCOT's boat ride through real working greenhouses at The Land is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Living with the Land! [chuckles] It used to be called Listen to the Land.

categories.title: In Full Bloom
categories.intro: Picture time! Every picture is a famous Disney flower. Name the film it blossomed in. [excited] Stop and smell the clues.

choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! The enchanted rose. [whispers] Last petal falls, and so does the spell.

categories.title: Spring Cleaning
categories.intro: Finally, spring cleaning! Disney characters who tidy up, with a song. [laughs] Grab a broom.

art.prompt: A cozy cottage being spring-cleaned: a broom sweeping by itself, buckets of soapy bubbles, dishes stacked in a washbasin, a feather duster and open windows with blooming flowers outside, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Snow White sings this song while cleaning the dwarfs' cottage with forest animals.
choices: Some Day My Prince Will Come
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Whistle While You Work! [laughs] Squirrels make terrible dusters.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins tidies the nursery with a snap of her fingers while singing this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is A Spoonful of Sugar! [excited] And the medicine goes down.

clues.clue: In Tangled, Rapunzel's chores-and-hobbies morning routine is the song 'When Will My Life' do this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Begin! Seven a.m., the usual morning lineup. [chuckles] Chores, then paint the walls again.

clues.clue: In Fantasia, Mickey enchants a broom to carry water in this segment.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Sorcerer's Apprentice! [gasps] Bucket after bucket after bucket.

clues.clue: In The Sword in the Stone, Merlin shrinks his whole house into a bag while singing this magic song.
choices: That's What Makes the World Go Round
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Higitus Figitus! [laughs] The world's best packing technique.
